body.title: deleteEntitiesById storage primitive
body.summary: Add `export async function deleteEntitiesById(_db, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<void>` to src/db/entities.ts. In one write txn, for each id: resolve its u64 (skip if absent), delete the entity row, entityIdByString/entityStringByU64 maps, nameIndex entry, and cascade its incident out/in edges — reusing the same per-id removal core as deleteEntitiesForFile (:522) but keyed by explicit ids. Independent of the endpoint pass.
acceptanceChecks: deleteEntitiesById([id]) removes the entity (getEntity=>null) and its incident CALLS_HTTP in/out edges (inNeighbors/outNeighbors empty); other entities + edges untouched.
Deleting an absent/stale id is a no-op (no throw); a mixed batch of present+absent ids deletes the present ones and skips the rest.
